paragraphs: Bchex runs background screening for organizations that have to vet the people they hire, and it also sells continuous monitoring along with visitor and volunteer management. The company advertises that 92% of background checks are delivered in under 24 hours.

A customer requests checks in seconds, tracks progress in real time from a single dashboard, and gets a report at the end. Candidates can scan a driver's license so their information populates automatically instead of being typed in. The platform connects to an applicant tracking system to sync and automate the screening process. Bchex puts terms behind the service: no payment if it misses its turnaround time or if the customer is unsatisfied, and a price match against a cheaper quote.

The company counts more than 2,000 school districts, non-profits, and US businesses among its customers. It states that it processes over 500,000 background checks per year. It describes nearly 30 years spent on this one line of work. The site states that Bchex is SOC 2 Type 2 certified for security, confidentiality, and availability. Buyers pay per order, with no long-term contracts or subscription fees.
